title: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 05 Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support and Project Nurse Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) has officially released a notification for the recruitment of 05 Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support, and Project Nurse Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS, BDS, M.V.Sc. Any Degree, 12th, Diploma, ANM can use this chance and apply for the AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 . Interested candidates can fill in the application before the last date of application. Here we provide more details about the age limit,...
